title: Does anyone know how to make cutscenes in rpg maker xp ?

posts.author: SLICER7
posts.body: Does anyone know how to make cutscenes in rpg maker xp?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
it should work the same way as in all other makers:
you use one event as the controlling event that contains all the show text and show pictures you want while also giving move commands to all other events.
what is your exact problem with making a cutscene?

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
Try to study all the event commands, such as moving events, creating dialog boxes.
Then create a map event in "Auto Start" mode and create the sequence of events in it and at the end transfer the player to the first map of the game where he should start the journey.
